definitions.explanation: beauty of the highest or most extraordinary degree

examples.japanese: {絶美|ぜつび}の{景色|けしき}が{広|ひろ}がっていた。
examples.english: A scene of exquisite beauty spread out before us.

examples.japanese: この{絵|え}は{絶美|ぜつび}の{一作|いっさく}と{言|い}われている。
examples.english: This painting is said to be a work of supreme beauty.

examples.japanese: {夕日|ゆうひ}に{染|そ}まった{富士山|ふじさん}の{絶美|ぜつび}の{姿|すがた}に、{観光客|かんこうきゃく}たちは{息|いき}を{呑|の}んだ。
examples.english: The tourists gasped at the sublimely beautiful sight of Mount Fuji bathed in the setting sun.

notes:
A literary word emphasizing that something is beautiful to the highest possible degree. The prefix {絶|ぜつ} intensifies the meaning, conveying "beyond comparison" or "supreme." Primarily used in written and formal contexts, especially when describing scenery, art, or natural phenomena.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {絶美|ぜつび}の{景色|けしき}: exquisitely beautiful scenery
- {絶美|ぜつび}の{風景|ふうけい}: sublime landscape
- {絶美|ぜつび}の{作品|さくひん}: a work of supreme beauty

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {絶景|ぜっけい}: spectacular view — specifically refers to scenery, much more commonly used
- {美|び}: beauty — general, neutral term
- {麗|うるわ}しい: beautiful/lovely — literary adjective for refined beauty
- {壮美|そうび}: grand beauty — emphasizes grandeur and magnificence alongside beauty
